name: @ademkao/runnerctl
description: Manage GitHub Actions self-hosted runners on macOS and Linux with agent-friendly automation.

scripts.test: bash tests/smoke.sh && bash tests/scheduler.sh && bash tests/notify.sh && if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 tests/test_bot_controller.py; else echo 'python3 not installed; skipping optional bot controller tests'; fi
scripts.prepack: bash -n runnerctl && bash -n runnerctl-base && bash -n runnerctl-base-v06 && bash -n runnerctl-base-v05 && bash -n runnerctl-base-legacy && bash -n bin/runnerctl && bash -n bin/runnerctl-legacy && bash -n bin/runnerctl-cleanup && bash -n bin/runnerctl-host && bash -n bin/runnerctl-ci && bash -n bin/runnerctl-hooks && bash -n bin/runnerctl-queue && bash -n bin/runnerctl-queue-legacy && bash -n bin/runnerctl-scheduler && bash -n bin/runnerctl-scheduler-core && bash -n bin/runnerctl-notify && bash -n bin/runnerctl-notify-provider-telegram && bash -n bin/runnerctl-notify-provider-line && bash -n bin/runnerctl-notify-provider-webhook && bash -n bin/runnerctl-bot && bash -n install.sh && bash -n install-legacy.sh && node --check npm/runnerctl.js
